instruction.sound: Emma is preparing cake for her party. Choose the correct colour from below and finish colouring in the candles.

trainers.finishSound: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>ae-phoneme-m</voice> Yummy! All the slices of cake are ready!

instruction.sound: The balloons also need to be hung up in a special order. Look at the balloons that have already been hung up. Finish colouring in the balloons.

trainers.finishSound: Cool! <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>party-horn</voice> The balloons are party ready!

instruction.sound: Emma is serving different drinks at her party, and she wants to line them up in a roh. Make sure that the drinks are lined up correctly. Finish colouring in the drinks.

trainers.finishSound: Super! <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>drink pour</voice> All the drinks are lined up correctly. Lets get this party started!
